overview: A full-stack mutual fund investment platform with four user roles — Admin, Investor, Financial Advisor, and Data Analyst. Features a fund browser with 20+ seeded funds, side-by-side comparison charts, SIP and lump sum investment calculators, fund detail views with performance charts, and an admin dashboard for managing users, approvals, and fund data.
features: Role-based dashboards for all 4 user roles
Fund browser with 20+ seeded mutual funds, category/risk filters, and sorting
Fund detail view with historical performance charts and manager info
Side-by-side fund comparison for up to 4 funds with overlapping chart lines
SIP and lump sum investment calculators with 12% default return projections
Admin dashboard: user management, advisor approvals, inline fund editing
Financial Advisor and Data Analyst dashboards
Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
